_: NIM Agency source-controlled defaults. Checked into source and treated as read-only at runtime. Operator overrides are provided via CLI flags, not by mutating this file in place.

harness._: Bounds on the agency's own tool loop for rogue syndicates. max_iterations caps model turns; max_calls_per_turn refuses calls beyond it within one turn; call_timeout_seconds is per tool call, independent of the mission timeout; max_result_chars clips what one call returns to the model; token_budget caps prompt+completion tokens summed across all turns of one task.

relay._: BIRD relay (lib/dispatch/bird.py): link-layer faults are resent with capped exponential backoff and full jitter (or the server's Retry-After), within each anomaly row's max_attempts and this per-task budget. Anomaly classes and remedies live in data/agency/data/reference/anomaly.json.

validation._: Schema validation on datastore writes (requires jsonschema). enforce refuses a non-conforming write; warn writes it and records the errors. An entity listed here as warn holds records that do not yet conform (a migration state); move it to enforce when its records conform - see nim.agency data check. Agents (O4) and groups (O5) conform since 2026-10-15.

install._: Instance home: records (substations, vault), logs, and venvs. null resolves --home > NIM_HOME > this value > legacy ~/.nim/agency (if it exists) > the platform data dir; see `nim.agency install env`. Plan: .nim/work/plan.101426.installer.md

logging._: dir null: the instance home (see install)
